scope: Illustrative structural tanh network, not measurements from a trained checkpoint.

critical_tanh.certificate_status: Supplied exact structural identities for the Sylvester Hadamard family; this worksheet does not inspect a matrix.
critical_tanh.descriptor: W_1=H_32/32 for the Sylvester Hadamard matrix, W_l=I_32 for l>=2, and every bias is zero. H_32 H_32^T=32 I_32 gives first-layer rank 32. Every first-layer entry has absolute value 1/32, so each row has l1 norm 1 and C_col=1. In the family of orders n=2^k, the rank grows as n while C_col stays 1.
